item.title: Indonesian stocks tumble amid MSCI concerns
item.description: Indonesia’s IDX Composite index plunged 8% on Wednesday after MSCI (formerly Morgan Stanley Capital International) announced it would stop adding Indonesian stocks to its emerging markets indexes. The decision was driven by concerns over limited transparency, insufficient free float, and restricted market accessibility, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Britain unveils initiative to enhance online search standards
item.description: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has proposed a set of measures aimed at improving Google’s search services and ensuring that users, businesses, and publishers can benefit more fairly from the platform, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: HPI reveals 2025’s weakest passwords
item.description: The Hasso Plattner Institute for Digital Engineering (HPI) in Germany has analyzed millions of compromised accounts and profiles found on the darknet and identified the most frequently used—and most insecure—passwords of 2025, Azernews reports.

item.title: Mansory tuners transform exclusive hypercar
item.description: Luxury tuning company Mansory has revealed a special edition of the Koenigsegg Jesko Attack, one of the most exclusive hypercars in the world. With only 125 units produced and a price tag of around $3 million, this particular model has been customized for a client from the Middle East, Azernews reports.

item.title: Dark matter mapped in distant galaxies
item.description: A new high-resolution map of distant galaxies may help scientists unravel one of the universe’s greatest mysteries: dark matter, the invisible substance that helps hold everything together, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Industrial parks power Azerbaijan’s non-oil growth with Chinese and Turkish technologies
item.description: The Sumgayit Industrial Park exemplifies the success of this model.With 40 active resident enterprises over 640 hectares, the park has attracted 5.5 billion manats in investment and currently provides employment to 6,135 people, with a projected total of 8,800 jobs upon completion of ongoing projects. Total sales of resident enterprises have reached 15.4 billion manats, including 5.7 billion manats in exports.

item.title: SpaceX sets launch date for largest Starship
item.description: The 12th test launch of SpaceX’s next-generation Starship is scheduled for March 2026, marking the debut of the Starship V3 (Block 3) architecture, a more advanced and powerful version of the spacecraft, Azernews reports.

item.description: UN says Gaza faces a potential turning point, but uncertainty remains

item.title: Azerbaijan to grant tax incentives for World Urban Forum 13 in Baku
item.description: Azerbaijan will introduce a package of tax incentives in connection with hosting the 13th session of the World Urban Forum (WUF13) in Baku in 2026.

item.title: Azeri Light crude trades at $70.37 per barrel on CIF basis
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil at Italy’s Augusta port, on a CIF basis, increased by $1.06, or 1.53%, compared to the previous figure, reaching $70.37 per barrel, Azernews reports.
